purpose: Compare a plain task instruction, the strongest relevant legacy prompt and PROMPTS v2 under matched resources.

A.name: plain-instruction
A.description: The model receives only the task objective, source material, output format and shared resource limits.

B.name: best-legacy-framework
B.description: The model receives the task plus one preregistered strongest relevant frozen legacy prompt.

C.name: prompts-v2
C.description: The model receives the task contract and deterministically selected PROMPTS v2 modules, with the reliability harness active.

arm_specific_allowances.A: No framework-specific state or critic instructions.
arm_specific_allowances.B: Only the preregistered legacy framework may add instructions.
arm_specific_allowances.C: The composer, builder-critic loop and reliability harness may operate, but may not receive more model or tool budget.

primary_metrics: recovery success after forced context loss
critic identification of the first major defect

decision_rule.quality_gate: C must improve contract satisfaction or artifact quality without obtaining the result mainly through greater refusal, larger model budget or extra tools.
decision_rule.statistical_report: Report paired differences and confidence intervals; do not promote a win when the interval includes no meaningful benefit.

invalidating_failures: different model or quantization across arms
manual repair after seeing final results
C receives extra source or tool access
refusals counted as correct on answerable tasks
final_evidence_rule: This public apparatus may validate execution and expose defects. PROMPTS_V2_VALIDATED still requires independently held tasks not used for development.
